iOS 27 為 Apple Wallet、Messages、Notes 及其他系統 app（包括日曆）帶來大量新功能。以下為 iOS 27 Apple 日曆 app 的所有新功能介紹。

事件及提醒嘅自然語言輸入

日曆加入咗 iOS 27 嘅一項功能，我等咗好耐：自然語言輸入。

Apple 稱之為「智慧事件詳情」（Smart Event Details），由 Apple Intelligence 驅動。官方描述如下：

事件同提醒都適用此功能。當你建立或編輯事件時，可以輸入自然語言，事件詳情會根據你輸入嘅內容自動填寫。

如果你鍾意手動操作，都可以喺「設定」入面將呢個功能關咗，但我個人就非常滿意呢項新功能。

設計更新

Apple 喺 iOS 27 入面主要針對兩個位置更新咗日曆嘅設計：

  • 事件詳情檢視
  • 事件建立及編輯

當你㩒事件嘅時候，而家會以全新設計嘅卡片式彈出視窗顯示，事件選項經過重新排列，並加入圖示以提升視覺效果。

至於事件建立同編輯方面，iOS 27 一樣採用全新設計。同事件詳情一樣，Apple 已重新整理各項選項，並為每個類別加入圖示。

iCloud 日曆嘅顯示為忙碌／空閒選項

對現代數碼日曆嚟講，根據特定事件將自己標示為忙碌或空閒係一項相當基本嘅功能。但去到 iOS 27，呢個選項從來未喺 iCloud 日曆出現過。

如果你喺 Apple 嘅 app 入面用 Google 日曆，你會見到可以將自己標示為忙碌或空閒嘅事件選項，但 iCloud 日曆一直以嚟都欠缺呢個功能。

iOS 27 終於補返呢個缺口，為 iCloud 事件提供空閒／忙碌選項，好似你從 Google 同其他第三方日曆供應商攞到事件嘅時候一樣。

特大尺寸小工具

iOS 27 令你可以透過全新嘅特大尺寸，將主畫面同今日小工具變得前所未有咁大，而日曆支援兩款特大尺寸小工具。

你可以將「列表」（List）同「接下來」（Up Next）小工具設定做特大尺寸。每款都可以顯示比以往更多嘅事件同提醒，所以如果你行程緊密，新小工具將會非常實用。

特大尺寸小工具會佔用好多螢幕空間，但對於配備特大螢幕嘅 iPhone Duo 嚟講，應該特別實用。

Siri AI 升級

值得一提嘅係，Siri AI 帶嚟多項同日曆 app 相關嘅升級。

Siri 具備螢幕感知能力，能夠理解你嘅個人背景資訊，整體比以往更聰明、更強大。即係話佢成為管理日曆嘅更好工具。喺 iOS 27 嘅使用過程中，我發現自己更依賴 Siri 嚟處理事件同提醒。

另外，事件建立畫面入面新增咗一個視覺智能按鈕，等你可以用相機 app 入面嘅全新 Siri 模式掃描活動傳單。Siri 隨即會根據內容建立新事件。

My go-to transcription tool on the Mac, MacWhisper, is getting another major update today, adding real-time meeting transcription, significantly improved speaker identification, deeper integration with Apple Intelligence, and a brand new transcription model. Here's what's new.

MacWhisper's Apple Intelligence integration deepens

I've written in the past about how much I rely on MacWhisper, especially in my podcast production workflow.

MacWhisper was one of the first AI-powered transcription tools on the Mac. Since independent developer Jordi Bruin launched it in 2023, it's been steadily improving and expanding support for new models, services, and workflows.

These include automatic meeting recording, speaker identification, watch folders, system-wide dictation, local and cloud AI models, and integrations with services like Notion, Zapier, Obsidian, and n8n.

Today MacWhisper is being upgraded to version 15.2, introducing improved speaker identification powered by NVIDIA's Nemotron 3 Diarization model, which was announced just hours ago.

Which brings us to the other major feature of this update: real-time meeting transcription.

This feature has been high on MacWhisper's public roadmap for some time, and it's now finally here, allowing users to follow along, review, copy, or send live transcriptions during meetings as they happen.

As for the actual transcription model, MacWhisper 15.2 adds Alibaba's QWEN3-ASR transcription model, which supports 22 languages and features enhanced integration with Apple Intelligence, Siri, Spotlight, and Shortcuts on macOS 27.

Now, users running macOS — including those in the EU — can search transcripts system-wide, open them with Siri, pull text into Shortcuts, or reference what's currently on screen in a transcription within Siri or Apple Intelligence requests.

Finally, MacWhisper 15.2 adds folder and subfolder capabilities to help organize transcripts and meeting notes, and supports dragging and dropping existing transcripts into them from the sidebar.

According to the Financial Times, the latest court documents show that OpenAI is disappointed with the adoption of ChatGPT through Apple Intelligence, saying the partnership has "performed far below expectations" since its 2024 launch. Here are the details.

OpenAI is asking the court to rule before trial

In August 2025, Elon Musk said that X, now under SpaceXAI, would sue Apple and OpenAI over alleged collusion to exclude AI competitors — stemming from OpenAI's deal with Apple to integrate ChatGPT into Apple Intelligence and Siri.

Once formally filed, the lawsuit actually went beyond Musk's original public complaint about App Store rankings. X and SpaceXAI also accuse Apple of trying to suppress the development of "super apps," including X's efforts to turn itself into an "everything app."

In the weeks and months that followed, all the companies involved filed briefs, allegations, and defences with the court. One point Apple and OpenAI have consistently argued is that their agreement was not exclusive, as the complaint claimed; at the same time, the court filings also revealed new details about how the partnership operates behind the scenes.

One of those details was exposed in a filing OpenAI submitted today. As the Financial Times first reported, OpenAI "said it was disappointed that Apple generated so little interest among iPhone users after the two companies reached a deal in 2024 to have ChatGPT power 'Apple Intelligence.'"

The report continues:

Wednesday's court documents point out that when the deal was struck in 2024, OpenAI expected a "halo effect" from Apple's promotion and co-branding, along with more subscriptions from Apple Intelligence users. But a month after the ChatGPT integration launched, it "appeared to get off to a slow start," and OpenAI began lowering its projections for weekly active users it could attract. The documents note that by summer 2025, "it had become clear that the ChatGPT integration had performed far below their expectations."

The report notes that several passages in today's filing are redacted, but the unredacted portions show that OpenAI executives were concerned Apple might "want to move faster" to find another AI partner.

When Apple Intelligence was first announced in 2024, Craig Federighi said in an interview that Apple ultimately wanted users to be able to choose between different AI models, and explicitly mentioned Google Gemini as a potential future integration target.

That particular partnership never materialised, but Apple later turned to Google's Gemini model to help power the new Siri AI features, and Xcode has also been expanded to support coding agents from Anthropic, Google, and OpenAI.

Top comment posted by OliveCocktail

As others have mentioned, when I want to use ChatGPT, I just go straight to its standalone app. In fact, that's also my preference, because I don't want all my voice requests jumbled together. I'd rather let Apple handle my personalisation and contextual stuff. I've never been clear on the privacy implications of using the ChatGPT 'integration,' and I can't even be bothered to find out, because I know I won't use it. On the contrary, when it comes to privacy, I'm completely comfortable using Apple Intelligence/Siri.

Returning to today's documents, the Financial Times notes that the filings also mention that the way Apple rolled out ChatGPT may have been one of the reasons for the slow adoption, because the integration was off by default.

Finally, according to Reuters, OpenAI is also arguing that SpaceX's recent securities filings undermine SpaceXAI's allegations that the Apple partnership harms competition. OpenAI said in its filing that SpaceX's IPO registration statement is "filled with disclosures that are the exact opposite of the competitive harm alleged in the lawsuit."

For these reasons, OpenAI is asking Judge Mark Pittman to rule in its favour on SpaceXAI's antitrust claims before trial. The case is currently scheduled for trial in January.

今晚活動上,Meta亦公布Muse Charm——一款掌心大小、圍繞近期推出的Muse個人AI代理而設計的裝置。Muse於本月較早前推出,應用程式隨即登上美國App Store及Google Play榜首。

用戶可透過iPhone或Android上的Muse應用程式設定及同步Charm。將兩部Charm放近,兩機亦可互相識別及互動。

Meta計劃於12月開售Muse Charm,公司尚未公布定價,但《彭博》指預計售價與智能手錶相若。

Apple is about to launch a new iPad mini. After a gap of two years, the device is finally getting its first update, and it's expected to be a major upgrade. Here's everything we know so far about the all-new iPad mini, which is expected to debut next month.

OLED Display

The biggest change on the new iPad mini, visible from afar, is the display. According to multiple sources, the 8th-generation iPad mini will feature an OLED display.

Compared to the existing LCD panel, this would be a significant upgrade. For users, switching to OLED means deeper blacks, richer colours, and better contrast. The iPhone X became the first iPhone to adopt an OLED display in 2017, while the OLED version of the iPad Pro made its debut in 2024.

However, there's still one unanswered question: whether the new iPad mini will feature a ProMotion display to support a refresh rate of up to 120Hz. According to a source from last week whose identity is unknown, the new iPad mini will not offer ProMotion support, with the refresh rate capped at 60Hz.

Nevertheless, no other sources have been able to corroborate this, so I'm still holding out a slim hope that this leak is wrong.

New Chip

The current iPad mini, launched in October 2024, comes equipped with Apple's A17 Pro chip. The new iPad mini is very likely to adopt the A19 Pro or A20 Pro chip, which will bring a noticeable performance boost and may also support the most advanced Siri AI features in iOS 27.

Better Water Resistance

According to a Bloomberg report, Apple has tested a "redesigned" casing for the iPad mini with water resistance similar to that of the iPhone.

Whether this water-resistant casing ultimately makes it to market remains unknown, but if successful, it would make the iPad mini more durable. This is especially important for users who use it as an e-reader, since water resistance is precisely one of the key selling points of dedicated e-readers like the Kindle.

New Speaker Technology

The 8th-generation iPad mini may also become the first Apple device to feature an all-new vibration-based speaker system. With this vibration-based speaker system, Apple can remove the speaker grilles, helping to achieve a water-resistant design.

By contrast, while the iPhone has speaker grilles, Apple uses seals and adhesives to achieve water resistance.

New iPad mini Release Date

According to the latest Bloomberg report, Apple is targeting an October launch this year for the OLED iPad mini. The upgrade is said to be "the biggest revamp of the iPad mini in half a century."

As for the pricing of the new iPad mini, there's no information at present. Apple raised the price of the current iPad mini from US$499 to US$599 in July (currently on sale at Amazon for US$569). Whether the new OLED iPad mini will be even more expensive remains to be seen.

I have been using Photoshop's generative AI features since Adobe introduced them in 2023 to remove unwanted objects and extend photos. The results have been hit or miss for me, but it's certainly much faster than the traditional methods of masking, cloning, and manual painting. However, with the release of iOS 27, Apple has significantly enhanced its Clean Up tool and added a new Expand tool, and I was curious to see how Apple's features compare to Adobe's. So, I enlisted a friend to test both against each other with a variety of photos to see which comes out on top.

For this article, my friend Jürg graciously provided several photos from his travels around Switzerland and Europe. He takes much better photos than I do, and the subject matter is far more interesting than my corner of Ohio. You can see more of his photography on Instagram. I selected six photos from his collection: three to test object removal and three to test expansion.

All photos were shot on an iPhone 17 Pro Max and edited on an iPhone 18 Pro Max running iOS 27.0. The iOS 27 Clean Up tool has three options: Auto, Quick, and High Quality. I left the setting on Auto for all three tests.

Photoshop tests were conducted on a MacBook Pro running Adobe Photoshop 27.10.0 with the "Firefly Fill & Expand" model. I used the Object Selection tool or lasso tool to select objects, then chose Generative Fill and left the prompt blank.

When using the Expand tool, I went with the photo's preset selected expansion area. The Photos Expand tool limits how much you can extend the edges of an image, while Photoshop has no such restriction. To keep the tests as consistent as possible, I used Apple's Photos result as the reference point and had Photoshop generate a similarly-sized output.

I did my best to keep the HDR presentation consistent between the photo edited in iOS 27 Photos and the one edited in Photoshop, but there are slight differences between the two.

Making Objects Disappear

Right: iOS 27 Clean Up tool

The first test was removing a red chair in front of a yellow door. This was the first photo I tested with the new Clean Up tool, and I have to say, I was quite impressed. The result looks very realistic, and the only obvious mistake I noticed was that the rivets behind the chair's left armrest were also removed and not properly reconstructed. But I don't think most people would notice that issue, and it would be easy to fix by cloning it back in from Photoshop. What really impressed me was that the shadow under the chair was replaced with textures matching the surrounding scene, while also preserving the existing light.

Right: Adobe Photoshop Generative Fill

Photoshop didn't perform as well as Apple's Clean Up tool here. The shadow from the chair is still there and looks more like an oil slick. The rivets on the door are misaligned, and one is clearly missing. The replacement texture also contains noticeably more visual artifacts. Overall, it's far less clean and realistic than the Clean Up tool's result.

I was impressed by the Clean Up tool's performance here. Not only did it remove the bread plate, but it also filled in a nice reflection of cups and bottles. Note how it even correctly rendered the spoon handle in the reflection—that's a very nice touch. The Clean Up tool also thoroughly removed the shadow the plate cast on the napkin. I thought removing a red plate from a similarly colored red table would pose a greater challenge for the Clean Up tool, but that wasn't the case! If I'm being picky, the Clean Up tool left behind some breadcrumbs from the plate, but running Clean Up on that area again would easily fix it.

Photoshop's removal of the bread plate was okay, but it also had issues with the leftover shadow, making it look out of place. The napkin here looks dirty or wet, but at least Photoshop didn't leave as many pesky breadcrumbs as before.

This photo was a much tougher test for the Clean Up tool. After attempting to remove the man on the right, the Clean Up tool left a messy, artifact-filled result. The leaves became overly chunky. It also struggled significantly with the white-haired woman behind the white flowers on the left side of the image. The Clean Up tool also left a "ghost" of the dog's head, which could barely be argued to blend in with the stone wall, but is much more obvious in this side-by-side comparison.

Photoshop had no trouble removing both the woman behind the white flowers on the left and the man behind the leaves on the right, and naturally filled in both areas. The end result is a highly convincing photo that looks as if no one was ever standing there. Photoshop also avoided leaving any phantom shadows this time.

Adding to the Scene

I thought this photo of a winding old staircase was a good test subject because I didn't think either AI would immediately recognize what it was looking at, and I was curious how each would interpret the scene—or even process it. iOS 27's Expand tool seemed to interpret the photo as something more like a ceiling fan, handling the end of the staircase as a blade-like arc. Photoshop, meanwhile, just extended the staircase outward and did a surprisingly good job matching the wood grain.

The Expand tool truly lives up to its name here, performing excellently. It extended the scene very effectively, producing a highly convincing final image. Notice how the windows were realistically repeated, and while the bridge on the right side is perhaps a bit too smooth, it still comes across as quite believable.

Now let's look at Photoshop's performance. Wait, Photoshop, did you even try? This is an absolute failure by any measure. Pure, obvious AI slop. The window and roofline in the upper left of the photo are atrocious. The bridge on the right lacks the realistic arches that Apple created, and somehow, Photoshop had the waterfall suddenly change direction rather than extending along the existing waterway.

The Expand tool once again succeeded in producing a believable image—not perfect, but noticeably better than Photoshop's output. The Expand tool generated a realistic-looking table with books or magazines on it, and the flowers in the vase look far more realistic than what Photoshop produced. The decorative pattern above the left door also matches the original pattern in the photo remarkably well. However, there are some odd elements on the right side of the photo—the Expand tool inexplicably added a radiator, an extraneous wire, and a table.

Perhaps the biggest difference between the Expand tool and Photoshop lies in how the ceiling was handled. The Expand tool reproduced more of the wooden elements from the opposite wall, while Photoshop tried to turn it into something more like structural crossbeams.

Meanwhile, Photoshop seems incapable of generating an image free of typical AI artifacts. Its table has too many legs and appears to simply "break" and blend directly into the floor. The decorative pattern above the door is also not convincing enough—missing one "swirl" pattern, and lacking the textured paint quality of the real decoration.

I won't say either side achieved perfection, but in terms of realism, I think Apple's solution has a slight edge over Adobe's.

The Good, The Bad, and The AI Slop

It's worth noting that Photoshop requires a subscription to use, but the features I tested do not consume generative AI credits. Adobe does offer the option to select other AI models that may require credits, but I did not use those in my testing. Apple has also made it clear that some Apple Intelligence features "may have usage limits" and may charge for expanded use in the future.

It's clear that Apple has made major improvements to the Clean Up tool—it's a far cry from previous iOS versions. I had tried it before and always found it lacking, but now it really does an excellent job. The new Expand tool is equally impressive, and in my testing, it was clearly superior to Adobe's offering. Adobe offers unlimited revisions and the ability to adjust results via prompts, but I question the value of those advantages—if additional generations and prompts just produce more obvious AI slop. Apple may be more limited in this regard, but its initial results are simply far better.

Of course, results will vary depending on the photo, the complexity of the scene, and what you're asking the tool to do. These are simply the results I got with the photos I tested.

How about you: have you had a chance to try Apple's new Clean Up and Expand tools? If so, what did you think?

Although Apple's revamped personal assistant is undoubtedly the headline feature of macOS 27 Golden Gate, this year's update has plenty of other new features and improvements that don't involve Siri AI. Let me highlight a few of my favorite macOS 27 updates — be sure to check out my video where I'll demo them one by one.

App icon overhaul

macOS 27 has revamped nearly every built-in app icon, with icons like Siri, Preview, and Chess receiving complete redesigns. Others like Finder, Photos, and Reminders have seen notable updates, with the trend leaning further into the Liquid Glass design language. In macOS Golden Gate, hardly any app icon escapes changes, though many updates are quite subtle.

If you check out my video below, you'll see a slider comparison showing the differences between each app icon in macOS Tahoe and macOS Golden Gate.

Some updates like Photos I really like, but others like Finder I'm not fully sold on. What are your thoughts on these app icon changes? Be sure to let me know in the comments below.

Video: macOS 27 top features and changes

Full HDR support

One of the most beautiful things about macOS 27 is its full visual support for HDR across the operating system. Elements of the Liquid Glass design language — icons, toolbars, and other parts — now benefit from additional dynamic range, and users with supported HDR displays will notice the difference immediately.

To see which elements have additional dynamic range, you can use macOS's built-in Digital Color Meter tool to check where shadows or highlights get clipped while viewing native SDR values. Be sure to check out my video where I'll explore different parts of the OS to demonstrate HDR support.

If you're using a Studio Display XDR, you've undoubtedly already noticed the difference, but even if you're not willing to shell out for Apple's most expensive display, you can still enjoy these benefits on supported third-party HDR displays.

I recently got hands-on with Asus's ProArt QD-OLED 32-inch 4K display, and thanks to the panel technology, HDR looks outstanding across the entire OS. Unlike Apple's first-party displays with Extended Dynamic Range support, you'll need to go to Settings > Displays and enable the High Dynamic Range option to access these benefits.

I recently started using the Dell UltraSharp U3226Q QD-OLED display and I'm really happy with it — a review video is coming soon. On both displays, HDR elements really pop, like the cursor blinking in the new Spotlight/Siri AI interface design.

Design updates

macOS Golden Gate has many design updates that address user complaints about macOS Tahoe. One of my biggest complaints was that some windows had misaligned corner radii.

Of course, that wasn't the only complaint addressed, but for me it was the most important one. Other fixes include floating sidebars returning to edge-to-edge sidebars, redesigned toolbars with prominent dividers, and improvements to the Liquid Glass effect itself, including a new slider that gives users more choice between transparency and tint.

Cleaner menus

Another major user complaint about macOS Tahoe was that menus had a lot of unnecessary stuff added, making them cluttered. In macOS Tahoe, nearly every menu option had a corresponding icon, making menus a complete mess.

If every menu item has an icon, you'll eventually run out of meaningful icons to use, while also making existing icons less effective. I'm glad Apple finally fixed this issue.

iPhone Mirroring

iPhone Mirroring in macOS 27 has three major improvements that make this feature much more useful in Golden Gate.

  • You can now access Control Center from the mirrored iPhone.
  • You can adjust the size of the iPhone Mirroring interface to match the aspect ratio of an iPad mini.
  • You can play DRM-protected content from your iPhone on your Mac with no more black screen.

Needless to say, iPhone Mirroring has become much more practical in macOS 27!

9to5Mac's take

Although Siri AI has taken most of the headlines, macOS Golden Gate is much more than just Siri. I've highlighted a few of my favorite new features in this article, but there's still plenty more to discover. Check out my full video for a look at everything new, and let me know in the comments below what your favorite new feature is.

Plante喺2008年接受《National Inquirer》訪問時，確認咗同Hulk Hogan嘅關係。Hulk Hogan本名Terry Gene Bollea。佢同呢份小報講，佢同呢位WWE冠軍嘅關係係發生喺佢嘅太太Linda Marie Claridge「離開咗佢」之後。

Hogan聲稱當得知老婆想離婚時佢感到「震驚」，《Today》報道。Claridge喺1983年同Hogan結婚，並喺2007年提出離婚，離婚喺2009年正式完成。

Brooke Hogan同《Us Weekly》講，喺佢哋父母婚姻結束之後，「我哋成家人嘅結構都變咗」。

「隨住時間推移，事態變得越嚟越複雜，最後我一直相信可以捱過任何嘢嘅關係，最終都撐唔住圍繞住我哋發生嘅事。」佢分享道。「呢個可能係我最希望大家明白有關Hogan家庭嘅事：公眾嘅觀感會將家庭簡化為英雄同惡人。」

Brooke Hogan補充話：「真實嘅家庭冇咁簡單。」

佢仲大方談及佢家庭「巨大嘅愛」同「功能失調」之間嘅雙重性。

佢話「恐懼、怨恨、巨大嘅背叛、金錢、名氣、形象管理同埋幾十年嚟未解決嘅傷痛」全部喺佢屋企「同一個屋簷下」存在。佢補充話：「我可以深愛我嘅父親，同時仍然講得出佢傷害我嘅地方。我可以感謝屋企畀我嘅美好嘢，同時承認到最後嗰種互動模式已經係我冇辦法再忍受落去。兩樣嘢可以同時係真。」

Brooke Hogan話佢嘅父親——喺2025年7月24日因心臟病發過世，享年71歲——喺好長一段時間入面「對我嚟講仍然係一位好好嘅父親」。

「我同爸爸之間嘅根基係非常堅固嘅。」佢話。「佢捱過咗公眾嘅醜聞、私人嘅痛苦、離婚、家庭嘅巨大轉變同疏遠嘅時期，因為喺呢一切底下有一段好真實嘅感情。」

吉米基梅爾周三為美國總統特朗普站台，對於他剛剛在白宮隆重推出的那個新一代全網絡高清頻道一事帶來了一個壞消息。

「目前為止，這個頻道的表現跟特朗普其他所有叫得出名字的東西一樣。」基梅爾說。

9743123c8f7d.content:
Roseanne Barr 早前猛烈抨擊她昔日一位合作演員，斥責對方是「被洗腦的偏執狂」；事緣該演員最近對 2018 年《Roseanne》重啟版腰斬一事發表毫不修飾的看法。

Barr 星期三亮相《Can't Be Censored》Podcast 節目時，在一輪火爆言辭中向演員 Michael Fishman 開火。Fishman 曾在 1988 至 1997 年播出的原版《Roseanne》，以及 2018 年的重啟版中飾演 D.J. Conner。

她說：「他他媽的根本不知道我說了什麼，雖然我已經在網上花了九年時間解釋了一萬次。他根本沒有花時間去聽我說的話，因為他是個偏執狂。而且他是個被洗腦的偏執狂。」

Barr 在描述 Fishman 要求她解釋那些導致 ABC 在播出一季後便腰斬《Roseanne》重啟版的種族歧視言論時，她如何回應時繼續大爆粗口。

她說：「我跟他說：『讓我跟你解釋一下，Michael，去你媽的，這輩子都別翻身。別再提我他媽的名字，閉他媽的嘴。』她續說：『你是個無知的人、偏執狂，你根本不知道我說過什麼，因為我說的話跟你被人硬塞進喉嚨和屁股裡的民主黨綱領完全矛盾。所以去你媽的。你根本沒有任何地緣政治背景來評論我說的話。』」

上個月，Fishman 在 Instagram 發放一段影片，回應一名網民的留言。該網民為 Barr 辯護，稱她只是「說了喜劇演員常講的玩笑話」，反而是美國「背後插刀」她。

Fishman 形容該留言「無知而且不符事實」，他說：「我想世人未能汲取教訓，所以我要指出——我們一直在延續一個謊言，有人正利用政治煙幕來為不可饒恕的行為開脫。」

他續說：「可惜的是，這一次根本不是甚麼笑話。而該劇被腰斬是完全正確的。」

Barr 與 Fishman 都是參與《Roseanne》重啟版的元老演員之一，該重啟版於 2018 年 3 月首播時收視率極為驚人。評論界亦讚賞新版劇集，將其與原版相提並論，認為它忠實地描繪美國白人藍領家庭。

不過，ABC 於同年 5 月底突然腰斬《Roseanne》，起因是 Barr 在 X（前稱 Twitter）發佈的一系列帖文中，將前白宮顧問 Valerie Jarrett（她曾在奧巴馬總統任內任職，亦是一名黑人女性）比作猿人，言論極具冒犯性。

腰斬《Roseanne》後，ABC 隨即宣佈開拍衍生劇《The Conners》，該劇由 2018 年播至 2025 年。Fishman 於 2022 年該劇第四季完結時退出。

Barr 是總統 Donald Trump 的高調支持者，雖然沒有參演《The Conners》，但一直在社交媒體上保持其具爭議性的曝光率。最近幾星期，她不斷抨擊紐約市市長 Zohran Mamdani 及其他民主黨人。

在她亮相《Can't Be Censored》的節目其他環節中，Barr 表示已完成一部新劇集的製作，她形容該劇是「現代寓言」，更是「史上最他媽精彩的一套劇」。

她說：「如果個個都不是蠢蛋聯盟的話，這套劇就一早應該拍得出來。」不過她未有透露劇集名稱，也沒有公布發行計劃。

可按此觀看 Roseanne Barr 亮相《Can't Be Censored》的完整節目，她談及 Michael Fishman 的內容由大約 12:30 開始。

d986b73e00ec.content:
《周六夜現場》新星 Ashley Padilla 在接受 Amy Poehler 主持的 Podcast《Good Hang》訪問時，一開始還擔心自己會「悶到爆」——結果訪談展開不過約 15 分鐘，她就證明了自己完全相反的一面。

Padilla 當面向 Poehler 坦言，自己 16 歲時曾經被捕，還對警察說了極度失控的話，結果被法庭下令接受心理治療，而且必須由母親陪同出席。

Padilla 在分享這段往事前先作說明，指自己中學時是個「差到不得了」的學生，並形容自己為「壞女孩」。當 Poehler 問她究竟「惹了什麼麻煩」時，Padilla 直截了當答道：「被捕。」

Poehler 聽後大為震驚，Padilla 接著列出自己被控的罪名：「妨礙司法公正、拒捕……還有我媽媽駕車駛到現場時，我已經被銬上手扣趴在警車車頂上。」

「好型。」Poehler 說。

Padilla 解釋，事緣是當晚她帶著一個「假 Chanel」手袋，跟一個男孩一起從派對逃跑。

Padilla 說：「我當時就像在從一個派對跑走，但那裡之前發生過一宗撞車逃逸，所以警察已經在附近。」

由於警方已在場，她的朋友被逮捕，而警員發現對方手上還拿著 Padilla 的手袋，便斷定她一定在附近。

Padilla 說她躲進一叢玫瑰花叢裡大約四個小時，最後才被警察找到。

Padilla 笑著重現當時情景：「他們把我拉出來的時候，我說——他們還把這句話寫了下來……警報告裡面有寫——我說：『你這班仆街終於捉到我喇。』」這句話令 Poehler 笑得合不攏嘴。

Padilla 回想自己當年對警員說的那七句狂語，自己也不禁反問：「是衝著誰說的？！到底是說給誰聽？為什麼要這樣講？」

這位 33 歲的喜劇演員 2024 年加入《SNL》，她解釋由於當年只得 16 歲，法庭給她一個機會，只要她出席「與母親一起進行的法庭命令心理治療」，就可以將「逮捕紀錄」從「個人檔案中刪除」。

Padilla 續說，兩母女最終確實有去接受那個法庭命令的心理治療，但她的單身、一直以事業為重的母親明確表示，覺得整個過程完全是浪費她的時間。

Padilla 憶述：「她就坐在那裡，治療師說：『我想你們為我畫點東西。』我媽媽就說：『不畫。』」

Poehler 聽到這裡忍不住笑到拍枱，整個人幾乎趴到桌上。

Padilla 一邊笑一邊回憶：「那位治療師只好說：『……好呀。』我記得我媽媽就在那裡翻雜誌，一邊說：『我不會做這些的。』」

不過 Padilla 還是得乖乖參與，治療師指示她畫自己和一間屋。

Padilla 憶述：「我畫了一間屋和自己——Amy，我冇呃你——那位女士就問：『你為什麼把自己畫得比屋細呢？』我當時就答：『要把自己塞進屋裡面嘛？』」

治療師不同意這個解釋，告訴Padilla 那是因為她覺得自己「渺小」。

Padilla 形容治療師的解讀「實在太離譜」——尤其是訪談早段她才說過，因為母親以身作則，她從小就「什麼都不怕」，從不覺得自己「在這個世界太渺小」。

Padilla 講到故事尾聲時提到，不知道為什麼她那細佬 Teddy 當時也被帶到治療 session，他很樂意地配合治療師，也畫了一幅自己站在屋旁邊的畫。

Padilla 笑著說：「他就畫了一座城堡，城堡旁邊有個叫 Fred 嘅男人被電到起火花。」治療師就說：『這一幅我要留起來存檔。』」

Padilla 說她媽媽對治療師對細佬那幅畫的反應非常不滿。

Padilla 說：「之後我媽媽揸車返屋企時就話：『好嘢！而家連 Teddy 都會被人拎走喇！』」

Qualcomm與Apple續簽全球專利授權協議，將原本於2027年到期的合約再延長。以下是詳細內容。

續約將於明年生效

說Apple同Qualcomm嘅關係波折重重，絕對唔為過。

兩家公司曾經係主要生意夥伴，但喺2017年因為Qualcomm嘅專利授權方式同專利費支付問題，陷入咗一場大規模嘅法律戰。

簡單嚟講，Apple喺2017年初喺美國聯邦法院入稟狀告Qualcomm，挑戰Qualcomm嘅專利授權方式，並追討Qualcomm被指不當扣起、合共近10億美元嘅專利費回扣。

呢場官司發生前僅三日，美國聯邦貿易委員會（FTC）亦已經起訴Qualcomm，指控佢從事反競爭嘅授權行為。訴狀特別提到Qualcomm同Apple嘅交易，指Qualcomm以數十億美元嘅有條件回扣作招徠，要求Apple喺新出嘅iPhone同iPad上獨家採用Qualcomm嘅 modem晶片。

幾個月後，Qualcomm反告Apple，指控Apple違反協議，並插手破壞Qualcomm同iPhone、iPad生產商嘅關係。

呢場糾紛最終喺2019年結束，Apple同Qualcomm同意撤銷喺全球範圍內對對方提出嘅所有訴訟。

作為和解條件之一，Apple向Qualcomm支付咗一筆金額未公開嘅款項，解決咗喺訴訟期間Apple扣起專利費嘅爭議。兩家公司亦同時簽訂咗一份為期六年嘅全球專利授權協議，以及另一份為期多年嘅晶片組供應協議。

該授權協議於2019年4月1日生效，當中包含一項Apple可選擇再延長兩年嘅條款。Apple最終行使咗呢個選擇權，將協議延長至2027年3月。

Qualcomm今日宣布，兩家公司再度續簽協議，新協議將於2027年4月1日生效。

新聞稿全文如下：

Qualcomm Incorporated今日宣布，與Apple續簽全球專利授權協議，新協議於2027年4月1日生效。Qualcomm技術授權（QTL）部執行副總裁兼總經理John Han表示：「我哋好高興能夠延長同Apple嘅授權協議。」

Qualcomm冇透露續簽後嘅協議有效期，而Apple至今仍未就續約一事作出回應。

值得留意嘅係，今次嘅宣布同Apple喺iPhone上使用Qualcomm modem無關——呢方面近期備受討論，因為Apple喺美國版iPhone 18 Pro Max用咗Qualcomm嘅modem，而喺其他地區就用咗自家嘅C2 modem。

Apple官方仍未正式透露未來嘅modem計劃，但外界普遍預期，Apple最終會完全放棄採用Qualcomm嘅modem。

想睇Qualcomm嘅原本公告，請按呢個連結。

特朗普及其政府正面對的後果之一，是三家新聞機構提出訴訟，聲稱這次禁令是「對《第一修正案》的直接攻擊」。

白宮採訪輪替決定停拍白宮日常活動後，其中一個事件發生在星期一南草坪的剪綵儀式。

愛荷華州得梅因（美聯社）——一名法官週三駁回總統特朗普對《得梅因紀事報》及其前民調專家提起的訴訟。特朗普指控該報及其民調專家歪曲2024年總統選戰的選情，並聲稱該報的民調報道違反了愛荷華州的消費者欺詐法，惟法官拒絕接納此說法。

愛荷華州地方法院法官斯科特·J·貝亞蒂（Scott J. Beattie）裁定民調專家J·安·塞爾澤（J. Ann Selzer）一方與《紀事報》一方勝訴。塞爾澤與《紀事報》將這宗訴訟形容為陰謀論，是對言論自由保障的侮辱。

法官在裁決書中寫道，特朗普的訴訟試圖將愛荷華州的成文法及普通法「擴張至超越其現行界限，把受到《第一修正案》最高級別保障的言論變成可招致法律責任的行為」。聆訊之後，法官認定憲法保障「過於重要，而訴訟的觸及範圍過於寬廣。本案必須予以駁回」。

特朗普及其團隊已先後對多家傳媒機構提起多宗訴訟，指控它們存有偏見，並藉此質疑《第一修正案》對言論及新聞自由的保障邊界。其中部分訴訟最終以和解收場。

特朗普於2024年12月對塞爾澤、《得梅因紀事報》及該報的母公司提起訴訟，指控他們蓄意發布失準的民調結果，以圖打擊他並協助民主黨，並聲稱民調的相關報道並不屬於受保障的言論。

共和黨籍聯邦眾議員瑪麗安妮特·米勒-米克斯（Mariannette Miller-Meeks）及前愛荷華州州參議員布拉德·祖恩（Brad Zaun）加入成為原告。塞爾澤及其他被告曾要求將案件移送聯邦法院審理，惟經過長達一年的法律程序後，首場聆訊最終於今年在州法院進行。

該項民調由塞爾澤的公司在2024年10月最後數天進行，並於2024年大選投票日前數天發布。民調結果顯示，當時的民主黨總統候選人、副總統賀錦麗（Kamala Harris）在愛荷華州可能投票的選民中獲得47%支持，特朗普則為44%。

特朗普最終在近200萬名愛荷華州選民中，取得56%的支持。

特朗普、米勒-米克斯及祖恩聲稱，具誤導性的報道損害了他們的聲譽、競選最後階段的寶貴時間，以及競選資金與資源。

塞爾澤的案件由言論自由倡議組織「個人權利與表達基金會」（Foundation for Individual Rights and Expression）接手處理。在分別提交的法庭文件中，塞爾澤以及《紀事報》與其母公司Gannett Co.均辯稱，無論民調或新聞機構對民調的報道是否以牟利為目的，法院從未將它們視為商業言論。

他們指出，無論相關民調報道對選情的捕捉準確與否，均屬於受憲法保障的政治言論。

他們同時反駁消費者欺詐的指控，強調該民調及其相關報道，與塞爾澤公司、《紀事報》與特朗普、米勒-米克斯或祖恩之間的任何交易並無關連。

James喺周二嘅記者會上表示：「伊朗唔可以有核武，但我一直主張我哋必須動用一切可用資源，盡快結束呢場戰爭。冇人想打仗，我哋嘅退伍軍人更加唔想。」

同樣喺周二，威斯康星州共和黨州長提名候選人、眾議員Tom Tiffany亦呼籲制定撤離方案。

Tiffany接受Fox6Now訪問時話：「我純粹認為我哋應該撤出伊朗，到時候轉移焦點。我哋已經摧毀咗佢哋嘅核設施，削弱咗佢哋嘅軍事力量，佢哋大部分船艦都已經沉落海底。係時候返屋企，處理美國自己嘅事務。」

Husted接受Politico訪問時補充：「我唔識任何一個唔想戰爭結束嘅人。」

Husted其實唔使問其他人，特朗普本人就對結束呢場軍事冒險興趣不大。據報特朗普上週向霍士新聞記者Trey Yingst表示，摧毁整個國家可能係佢唯一嘅出路。

據報特朗普當時話：「我嘅問題係，我幾時應該炸毀成個國家？佢哋最好識啲規矩。」

第一夫人梅拉尼婭·特朗普周三在霍士新聞節目亮相時，對丈夫、美國總統唐納德·特朗普的工作表現作出頗為冷淡的評價，她選擇讚揚總統的工作態度，並指他在民望持續低迷之際「已盡最大努力」。

梅拉尼婭·特朗普周三早上亮相《Fox & Friends》節目，之后前往紐約證券交易所敲響開市鐘，她利用這兩個機會宣傳Imperia——一個專為女性商界高管建立人脈而設的邀請制平台。

在推介新項目以及丈夫為結束俄羅斯入侵烏克蘭所作的努力後，《Fox & Friends》聯合主持Brian Kilmeade問梅拉尼婭·特朗普，她如何看待丈夫「以不同方式」處理職務，與他首個任期時有何分別。

她回應說：「他非常專注，手頭上有很多事情要處理。」她進一步解釋道：「現在世界各地發生的事情非常不同，但我認為他已盡最大努力。他不停地工作，比任何人都更有精力。從早到晚，他都在不停地工作。」

總統的民望支持率本周初跌至32%，是其整個政治生涯中最低水平。美國正面對生活成本危機，而他對此大多不以為然，加上自二月以來針對伊朗的昂貴且不得人心的戰事，令情況更為嚴峻。

唐納德·特朗普在2024年爭取連任前曾承諾，透過振興美國製造業及避免美國捲入海外糾紛來推動美國經濟增長。然而，除了伊朗戰事及上述生活成本問題外，他還推行了損害經濟的國際關稅政策，並對通脹上升表示歡迎。

總統亦於周五禁止多家主要傳媒機構進入白宮，時值中期選舉季節，這對共和黨來說可能是一場災難。即使是對其連任至關重要的大學以下學歷選民，也開始放棄對他的支持。

梅拉尼婭·特朗普周三亦提到即將推出的紀錄片續集，承接去年的《Melania》紀錄片。該片由被指控性騷擾的Brett Ratner執導，他亦出現在Jeffrey Epstein的檔案中，以及與Epstein和兩名年輕女子的合照裡。

在結束訪問前，《Fox & Friends》聯合主持Ainsley Earhardt似乎進一步為即將推出的紀錄片造勢，她說：「我希望下一套電影可以帶我們看看你的衣櫥，因為你總是打扮得非常漂亮。」

前美式足球聯盟（NFL）球星外接手安東尼奧·布朗（Antonio Brown）計劃接受一項認罪協議，在一宗於邁阿密發生的企圖謀殺案中改以較輕控罪處理，從而避免入獄。其律師週三表示，與檢方達成的協議優厚，難以拒絕。

布朗定於9月30日出庭，完成有關協議的最終手續。辯護律師馬克·艾格拉什（Mark Eiglarsh）表示，布朗將就嚴重傷人罪作不抗辯認罪。他將被判處緩刑，刑期將予擱置，即布朗不會被視為重罪犯。艾格拉什指出，若布朗被裁定原來的企圖謀殺罪成，最高可被判監30年。

布朗被指於2025年5月16日在邁阿密一場名人拳擊賽後，從一名保安人員手中搶走手槍，並向一名他早前曾與之打鬥的男子開了兩槍。拘捕令指出，祖爾-卡奈因·誇梅·南坦布（Zul-Qarnain Kwame Nantambu）告訴調查人員，其中一粒子彈擦傷了他的頸部。

律師堅稱布朗原本可於庭審中勝出

艾格拉什週三發表聲明稱：「這不是一個容易作出的決定。安東尼奧相信自己是清白的。他堅信自己有『不退讓法』（Stand Your Ground）的抗辯理由，亦相信最終能在庭審中勝出。但當檢方提出一項將可能長達數十年的監禁刑期大幅減輕為緩刑的協議時，他根本無法合理地拒絕。」

佛羅里達州所謂的「不退讓法」容許認為自己面臨死亡或嚴重傷害的人，在無退讓義務下，使用致命武力自衛。

南坦布的代表律師理查德·庫珀（Richard Cooper）認為該認罪協議是公平的。

庫珀週三在一封電郵中表示：「我們對伸張正義感到滿意。當事人維持早前的立場：原諒布朗，且不會與執法機關合作。我們祝布朗先生身體健康，並希望他能從此事中有所成長。」

南坦布的律師曾表示他已決定原諒布朗

在一份較早的聲明中，南坦布的律師指出，身為虔誠穆斯林的他，經過「深入反思、祈禱，並與家人及法律顧問商議後」，決定原諒布朗。

邁阿密-戴德郡州檢察官辦公室週三拒絕置評，其發言人埃德·格里菲思（Ed Griffith）表示，有關細節將於下週的聆訊中「全面釐清」。

布朗曾在社交媒體上表示，他當時是為了自衛而面對襲擊，並聲稱有人企圖搶劫他的珠寶。

現年38歲的布朗在NFL征戰12年，是一位明星級外接手，最後一次上陣是2021年為坦帕灣效力期間，當時他與四分衛湯姆·布雷迪（Tom Brady）一同奪得超級碗冠軍。他的職業生涯大部分時間在匹茲堡度過。整個職業生涯中，布朗共錄得928次接球，累計推進超過12,000碼，連同回攻達陣及一次傳球達陣在內，共貢獻88次達陣。

布朗多年來屢涉法律糾紛

布朗於2025年11月從杜拜被引渡回國，他於當地擁有生意利益，此前他在2025年6月因企圖謀殺罪而被發出拘捕令。

布朗多年來涉及多宗法律問題。他曾被指控毆打搬家貨車司機、多項家庭暴力指控、未支付贍養費及其他事故。在2021年一場坦帕灣對紐約噴射機的賽事中，布朗脫下球衣、肩墊及手套後跑離場地，導致海盜隊將其釋放，其足球生涯亦大致告終。

在另一宗案件中，南坦布於今年較早前被裁定一項阻差辦公的輕罪罪成。警方指他在2025年干擾了肯德里克·拉馬爾（Kendrick Lamar）的超級碗中場表演。事發時南坦布是新奧爾良凱撒超級巨蛋球場內數十名舞蹈員之一，他手持一幅寫有「Sudan and Free Gaza」（蘇丹與自由的加沙）的蘇丹國旗橫越球場。其後他在拘捕令發出後向當局自首。

一位共和黨參議員誓言要傳召總統特朗普的兒子就其與一名俄羅斯寡頭的關係作證，並獲得了意想不到的支持，該寡頭曾於今年早前資助其婚禮。

共和黨猶他州參議員約翰・柯蒂斯（John Curtis）週二去信參議院司法委員會主席、愛荷華州共和黨參議員查克・格拉斯利（Chuck Grassley），要求調查小特朗普（Donald Trump Jr.）與與俄羅斯總統普京有聯繫的商人烏馬爾・克列姆廖夫（Umar Kremlev）的商業往来。

柯蒂斯的信件在ProPublica發表爆炸性報道數日後寄出，該報道發現克列姆廖夫租下巴哈馬一座私人島嶼，並為小特朗普今年早前與貝蒂娜・安德森（Bettina Anderson）的婚禮支付了一場煙花表演費用。

面對該報道，特朗普為克列姆廖夫的禮物辯護，稱其「完全被允許」，並指出其子已經「還錢給克列姆廖夫」。與此同時，安德森亦為克列姆廖夫這份「非常慷慨的結婚禮物」作出類似的辯護，她在Instagram上寫道：「友誼無需政治動機。慷慨不一定帶有目的。有時候結婚禮物就只是結婚禮物。」

然而，柯蒂斯在信中表示，共和黨人對待特朗普的兒子應該如同他們在2023年向前總統拜登之子亨特・拜登（Hunter Biden）發出傳票時那樣同樣嚴格地審視。

他寫道：「這個國家不應該對共和黨總統的家人採用一套標準，而對民主黨總統的家人採用另一套。」

他週二在X平台發文時進一步強調立場，指出：「多士爐是結婚禮物。一個由普京有關聯的寡頭買單的私人島嶼派對則是另一回事。共和黨人調查亨特・拜登的外國關係時差點把傳票機用到報廢。我們現在不應該把它關掉。」

柯蒂斯的信件被視為與共和黨的一種分歧，因為該黨普遍忽略對特朗普家族商業交易和自肥計劃的關注。然而，在信件送達格拉斯利後不久，司法委員會的另外兩名共和黨參議員表示支持柯蒂斯呼籲進行調查的請求。

北卡羅來納州共和黨參議員托姆・蒂利斯（Thom Tillis）即將退休，他將小特朗普接受克列姆廖夫的禮物形容為「至少是極其糟糕的判斷」，美聯社引述其言論。蒂利斯在接受《國會山報》（The Hill）的另一次訪問中補充說：「如果明年眾議院翻盤，那麼無論如何都會展開一項調查。」

德克薩斯州共和黨參議員約翰・科寧（John Cornyn）表達了類似觀點，他告訴《國會山報》：「我支持柯蒂斯參議員。我會支持柯蒂斯參議員的請求。」

這封信的消息也引來亨特・拜登俏皮的回應，他在X平台上寫道：「我父親擔任總統期間，我沒有從事任何外國商業交易。一次都沒有。我只是畫畫，現在仍在畫。任何時間、任何地點，我都願意與小特朗普並排作證。埃里克和賈里德也可以加入。不需要傳票。讓我們明天就一起作證吧。」

截至週二，格拉斯利承認他尚未閱讀該信件。他對《國會山報》表示：「我有些工作人員關注的是社交媒體公司的聽證會，今天也有人來向我提出相關要求。這是我正在處理的問題之一。」
